expo.name: Exposure Awareness

web.name: Exposure Awareness
web.description: A private, on-device way to see what you're exposed to, compare it with published guidance, and make your own changes.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Used only to check local air quality and significant weather/fire alerts near you. Never leaves your device except as a coordinate sent to the National Weather Service and Open-Meteo, both free public data sources with no account.

plugins.cameraPermission: Used to scan a barcode or photograph a product's label. A live barcode scan never leaves your device -- only the number it reads is sent to Open Food Facts or Open Beauty Facts (free public databases, no account). A label photo is sent only if you've connected your own backend for label reading; otherwise nothing leaves your device.
plugins.microphonePermission: Not used by this app -- the camera framework can record audio, but nothing here asks it to.

plugins.photosPermission: Used only if you pick an existing photo of a product's label instead of taking a new one. Sent only if you've connected your own backend for label reading; otherwise nothing leaves your device.
